fact: INSTAT reports the education ministry's planning directorate collected the 2022-2023 annual school census from schools, entered it in statistical software developed by the ministry's DTIC, and published the national yearbook.

Madagascar's authorities launched at a 15-17 July 2024 workshop in Toamasina the digitisation of schools, starting in Atsinanana, covering data collection and a pupil register, with the education ministry planning extension to other regions.

The article says work to modernise the education administration's information system was begun in 2023, and a 2025 Senate-adopted financing law for the TALIM programme provides for modernising the education management information system.
